messages:
Maya Chen: Quick follow-up from the last postmortem series: recurring authz failures after rolling deploys + intermittent missing audit records for service-account rotations. Need owners, short deadlines, and a post-deploy validation.

Nina Gomez: Agree. Minimal immediate mitigations: (1) post-deploy token smokecheck, (2) make rotation audit writes blocking with retry, (3) add basic orphaned-cred sweep.

Ravi Shah: Sample failure to use in smokecheck:
```
ERROR authz token_validation: signature verification failed, key_id=ks-3a9, trace=tx-9c1
```

Caleb Turner: I'll own the smokecheck + CI gate. Target: 2 weeks (due 2026-06-10).

Nina Gomez: I'll own audit-write reliability changes (sync write + retries + tests). Target: 10 days (due 2026-06-08).

Maya Chen: I'll add these to the remediation tracker and create a 30-min monthly "authz retro" to review patterns.

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-6234 assigned to Caleb Turner, due 2026-06-10

devsec-bot: Task created: AUTHZ-6235 assigned to Nina Gomez, due 2026-06-08

Maya Chen: Operational rule: if you can't meet your ETA, post an update 48h before so we can reassign or reduce scope. Thanks!
